decisions: D1 (token-bucket): a token bucket over a sliding window, because bursts are expected
constraints: C1 (no-new-deps): no new runtime dependencies, because the server ships as one binary

steps.title: Add the RateLimit type to the shared types
steps.done_when: RateLimit { max, window_ms } is exported from @sandbox/types, with a unit test

steps.title: Limit the login route
steps.done_when: the sixth login in a minute from one address gets 429; a test covers it
context: The login route is the only one limited in this build.

steps.title: Back off on 429 in the client
steps.done_when: a 429 is retried after Retry-After, at most three times; a test covers it
